note: Both sets capture the same core claims about the PID-controlled rotor-speed error response, the roles of the derivative, proportional, and integral terms, and the Ref. [10] design recommendations (ωφn = 0.6 rad/s, ζφ = 0.6–0.7, neglecting the derivative gain and the generator-torque negative damping). Set A additionally includes the correct and important claim that the sensitivity of aerodynamic power to rotor-collective blade pitch (∂P/∂θ) is negative in Region 3 for an active pitch-to-feather turbine, which Set B omits. Both sets repeat the generator-torque-controller negative-damping fact twice (once as a damping effect, once as an effect on speed error response).
remarks: Both sets state the generator-torque-controller negative damping twice under two attribute names; that fact should appear once. Set B's omission of the ∂P/∂θ < 0 fact is notable since it is the premise for the sign reasoning that follows. The text layer is heavily garbled around Eqs. (7-11)–(7-15), but the page image renders them legibly.
